message.content:
Yes – the United States lies within the geographic boundaries of **North America**.  
It occupies roughly the central portion of the continent, stretching from its northernmost point near Alaska all the way southward to the U.S.–Mexico border. In continental terms, North America comprises Canada, the United States, and Mexico (along with Greenland, which belongs politically to Denmark), so the U.S. is definitely one of those three core countries.
